evidence: store_id: low group overlap (0.00) → group split
why_generic_validation_is_risky: Random k-fold will put the same group in both train and validation, leaking group-level signal and inflating scores.

recommendation.reason: Prediction groups are largely unseen at training time — group leakage must be prevented.
recommendation.fit_rule: Train on a subset of groups; hold out a disjoint set of groups for validation.
recommendation.validation_rule: Ensure no group appears in both train and validation splits.
